Chapter 748: Chapter 32: How Did This Line Move On Its Own? (Please subscribe)_2

Regardless of whether he was asked or not, Lin Yuan’s strength would not be affected.

Xia Qin Supreme Being felt it was best to let Lin Yuan perform by himself.

“At least the Witch Ancestor’s Thirty-Five Realms.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being judged internally that Lin Yuan had easily forced back the Four Divine Kings and the other six powerhouses, all of whom were from the Ancestor Witch’s Thirty Realms or Thirty-One Realms.

Being just two or three realms stronger wouldn’t achieve this feat.

…

...

“How does human civilization have such good luck?” Far away, several ancestors of the Tianyu Clan looked at each other, feeling somewhat envious.

From the very beginning of their arrival, the Tianyu Clan had been eliminated. Now that the Heavenly Gate was open, the strong members of the Tianyu Clan simply could not be bothered to come.

“This powerhouse of human civilization, compared to his performance in the Two-dimensional World, even surpasses the Four Divine Kings. The hope of reaching the ultimate level in future must not be underestimated…”

The Insect Queens were quite worried since human civilization and the Insect Race were absolute mortal enemies, without any possibility of reconciliation.

While there might be potential cooperation between the Star Alliance and human civilization, cooperation between the Insect Race and human civilization? Even if they met without fighting, cooperation would be impossible.

In the Insect Queens’ view, if human civilization produced another Supreme Being in the future, the pressure they would have to bear would surge significantly.

…

Atop Heavenly Mountain.

The Four Divine Kings and the other six powerhouses wore expressions as solemn as water.

They were the closest to Lin Yuan and knew very well what level of powerhouse they were dealing with.

“How is he so much stronger than me?” A tumultuous wave surged in the heart of the Four Divine Kings.

For over three hundred years, he had not spent a day without enduring grueling cultivation, constantly seeking to merge the ultimate weapon within his body.

He had originally thought himself invincible in this two-dimensional world, confident that he could handle even an Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Strength like the skinny old man.

But Lin Yuan?

A great fear kept emerging in the mind of the Four Divine Kings at this moment.

He had a feeling that he definitely could not defeat the other party.

If he even thought of making a rash move, it could genuinely lead to life-threatening danger.

“What should we do now?” Not far away, the skinny old man glanced at the Four Divine Kings.

While the five of them and the Four Divine Kings were adversaries, they did not hesitate to join forces when confronted with a more formidable enemy.

“What to do?”

The Four Divine Kings felt hesitant as well.

The intention of the skinny old man was clear.

Would the six of them join forces to test Lin Yuan,

or simply leave right away?

“Let’s leave,” the Four Divine Kings said after a deep look at Lin Yuan, slowly retreating down the mountain.

He truly sensed a sort of life-threatening danger from Lin Yuan, so he decided to simply give up this chance at the opening of the Heavenly Gate.

For the Four Divine Kings, there was no point in fighting Lin Yuan for this chance at the Heavenly Gate; as long as he survived, there would be another opportunity to enter the Heavenly Gate next time.

Why did he previously engage in combat with the skinny old man and others? It was entirely because the Four Divine Kings felt no pressure and was fairly confident in defeating them.

But now?

The Four Divine Kings had not a shred of confidence, and even faced the possibility of being brought down here, naturally knowing how to choose.

“To leave?”

Upon seeing the movements of the Four Divine Kings, the other five powerhouses glanced at each other and began to retreat as well.

The five of them had already had severe difficulty dealing with the Four Divine Kings, let alone facing Lin Yuan, who dared not even engage.

“Couldn’t believe none of us would be the ones to enter the Heavenly Gate,” thought the skinny old man solemnly, his face tinged with sentimentality.

…

The voluntary retreat of the Four Divine Kings and the other six powerhouses caused tremors in the hearts of many watching from the Myriad Tribes.

Retreating without fighting is a show of weakness.

But are the Four Divine Kings weak?

How could they be weak?

The mere pressure they emitted pushed ninety-nine percent of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses out of the mountain’s waist.

The residual impact from their previous wild engagement even caused many Eleventh Rank Powerhouses to feel numbness in their scalps, not daring to stay at the summit any longer.

But now?

The Four Divine Kings and the other six had voluntarily retreated and given up the chance to enter the Heavenly Gate.

The only possible explanation was that the human ‘Blood Rain’ standing in front of the Heavenly Gate was beyond the limit of what the Four Divine Kings and the others could handle.

The Four Divine Kings didn’t even contemplate engaging.

…

“They just left like that?”

In front of the Heavenly Gate, Lin Yuan’s attention was mostly on the gate, but he was still aware of the Four Divine Kings and the other six powerhouses.

“The Heavenly Gate is right here, not even trying to probe?”

Lin Yuan was slightly astonished; after all, his statement of ‘whoever crosses this line, shall be killed’ was specifically intended to provoke the Four Divine Kings and the others.

The reason was that they carried many ‘wondrous items’ on them.

Other powerhouses from the Myriad Tribes didn’t dare to carry ‘wondrous items’ for fear of being plundered, but for ones like the Four Divine Kings and the skinny old man, beings of Eleventh Rank Perfect Life, this wasn’t a concern.

Even to maintain their combat power, these six powerhouses carried multiple wondrous items on them.

Therefore…

From the start to the end, Lin Yuan had never intended to let these six powerhouses go.

But if he were to attack and kill directly… there were many Supreme Beings watching from outside the canvas, and the Four Divine Kings were associated with the Star Alliance, which did not have a bad relationship with human civilization.

To kill without even asking… would undoubtedly look a bit unsightly.

Killing Tuoba Ancient God and other special beings was one thing; those had a minimal hope of reaching the ultimate level.

But the Four Divine Kings? Lin Yuan knew that the Four Divine Kings were treasures of the Star Alliance, their status not inferior to his own in human civilization.
